diagram_math_checks.evidence: With one fixed abelian coefficient group G, the top row is H_n(A;G), H_n(X;G), H_n(X,A;G), H_{n-1}(A;G); the bottom replaces X,A by Y,B. This is exactly the fragment in thm-long-exact-sequence-of-a-pair-in-singular-homology. The vertical arrows are covariant maps of degree n, n, n, n-1 induced by f|_A, f, the quotient-chain map, f|_A respectively; f(A) subset B guarantees their domains/codomains (prop-relative-homology-is-functorial-for-maps-of-pairs step 1.1).

For subspace inclusions i_A:A->X and i_B:B->Y, f i_A=i_B f_A, hence f_* i_*=i_* (f_A)_*. This is the restriction/ambient chain square in assigned proof step 1.1; passing to homology gives the drawn square.

def-singular-chain-complex-of-a-pair defines C_n(X,A;G)=C_n(X;G)/C_n(A;G). For the chain quotient q, q_Y f_#([before quotient] c)=[f_#c]=f_rel,# q_X(c), so f_rel,* q_*=q_* f_*. No identification with homology of the topological space X/A is asserted.

The pair sequence supplier sends H_n(X,A;G) to H_{n-1}(A;G). def-preconnecting-arrow-on-cycles specifies the usual lift-and-boundary recipe in modules; def-connecting-morphism-in-homology descends it to homology. For a relative cycle c with boundary in C_{n-1}(A;G), delta[c]=[boundary c]. Thus (f_A)_*delta[c]=[f_# boundary c]=[boundary f_#c]=delta f_rel,*[c], exactly assigned proof step 2.1 and cor-the-long-exact-homology-sequence-is-natural. There is no minus sign or cohomological variance/degree shift.
